title: Excelsior Brass Band and teacher Charlie Lipscomb
summary: He remembers no country blues singers, only the Excelsior Brass Band in which his teacher Charlie Lipscomb played, the man who forbade jazz.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Well, what about -- I'll tell you one thing that Trummy (PHONETIC) told us, was that blues singers used to come in from the country. And used to -- you know, play guitar, country blues singers.
Do you remember that at all?
I don't remember any blues singers like that.
No? Do you remember any little bands?
No. The only bands I remember was the brass band, the Excelsior Brass Band, which my teacher was
Yeah. He's the one that wouldn't let you play any jazz.
Yeah. He was the one that wouldn't let me play any jazz.
Well, tell us. You might just as well tell us about that, because you studied with him a long time, didn't you?
You got a terrific foundation from him.
